decisionsTitle: The platform's catalogues are neutral; this club's own sentences are an overlay in club/messages
decisionsSection:
**The owner (2026-11-01, §882):** «we should make an effort to have the entire app white-labeled cuz I might want to reuse this repo for another run club». **The brief**, the fourth step of that work: "The base catalogues become neutral, and club/messages/{ro,en}.json carries Brașov's own sentences verbatim. Every page, email and PDF Brașov renders reads exactly as today."

**Decision.** `messages/ro.json` and `messages/en.json` are the platform's catalogues and say nothing only one club could say. This club's own sentences are `club/messages/ro.json` and `club/messages/en.json`, an overlay that `src/i18n/catalogue.ts` lays over them once per process — objects merge key by key, a string or a list replaces the platform's whole, and the overlay's `"$club"` stamp must equal `club.json`'s `slug` and is taken off before the merge. `catalogue.ts` is the only file under `src/` that imports either catalogue (`tests/unit/club/import-surface.test.ts`): the request's configuration and the twenty-three files outside a request that read it (the legal texts' merge values, the emails' words, the calendar's, the starting list, the relayed message's words) read the merged catalogue, so a page, an email and a PDF never say two different things.

- **Facts arrive as arguments**, so a fork with an empty overlay is already right: the short mark `{short}` (`CLUB_SHORT_NAME`, the «BVR» messages and the member chip), the identity card example `{idExample}` (`ID_DOCUMENT_EXAMPLE`), the safety form's name `{safetyName}` (`SAFETY_PROGRAMME` in the reader's language — also in the relayed message's subjects and footer, which moved from `feedback/domain/branches.ts` into `Tell.relay`), and on «Sarcini» `{slug}`, `{timeZone}` and `{bucket}` (`R2_BUCKET`, else the slug's `-media` the step asks to create); the editor's zone line and «Sarcini»'s stalled-email alert read `{zoneWords}` (`ZONE_WORDS`). next-intl 4 has no default values and a missing one is quiet on production (§353), so every call site passes its value and `tests/unit/notifications/no-hardcoded-values.test.ts` pins them beside §369's `{club}`. The calendar picture's hashtags come from `CLUB_HASHTAGS` and their catalogue key is gone; the legal digest email says the zone through `ZONE_WORDS`; an email's `<html lang>` is its first half's language.
- **Sentences move to the overlay**, the platform's file getting a neutral one: the home page's title, description, hero and «why» item; the calendar's motto; the listing's and the specials' intros («ture pe munte», «întotdeauna gratuite»); the safety rule on animals; the newsletter's «crosul aniversar» hint; the backoffice examples naming Tâmpa, Poiana, Pădurea Noua and Șchei, and the coordinates' example; the hue labels («Albastrul clubului» → «Culoarea clubului»); the starting list's two lines; the dated history rows of `/admin/tasks` (the Neon review of December 2026, the domain bought from ROMARG, Launch chosen on 22 September, Zitadel checked on 27 September); and the redesign plan of `/admin/design`, a sub-tree only the overlay has — the section and its «Planul» link in the contents row are drawn only when it is there.
- **The overlay's rules** (`tests/unit/club/overlay.test.ts`): every key is a key of the platform's catalogue but the plan, with the same arguments, in both languages, under this club's stamp. `KNOWN_LEAKS` has no catalogue row any more, and `tests/fork/words.test.ts` formats every message of the platform's catalogue with a made-up club's values and finds none of this club's words. `yarn batch:merge` resolves `club/messages/*.json` key by key, like the platform's.
- **Brașov reads what it read:** the merged catalogues, the new arguments filled with Brașov's values, equal `origin/qa`'s for every one of the 9 826 keys of each language but the removed hashtags key and one staff-only English sentence: «Sarcini»'s stalled-email alert said «(Romania time)» and now says `ZONE_WORDS.en`, «(Romanian time)», as the editor's zone line already did; the legal texts' merge values are unchanged (`filled-hash-parity.test.ts` passes untouched). The staff-only sample data held in code became neutral (owner's decision 6, the default): the email previews' place, note and reason («Intrarea în Parcul Central»), the design page's sample place and square, the token legend's place. Since §359's guard looks for the sample's own values, it now refuses «Intrarea în Parcul Central» / «Central Park entrance» in a saved email text, and a stored text that still holds the old sample place («Stația de telecabină Tâmpa», as the pre-§359 starting text carried it) is no longer flagged on «Setări» → «Emailuri» — a Redactor's own words, sent as they are.

**Refused.** A codemod of the ~400 tests that import the catalogues — only those that now fail read the merged one. Empty strings in the platform's file for the plan — the catalogue test refuses an empty message, so the plan is the overlay's alone. A global default for the new arguments — next-intl 4 has none, and a wrapper would hide a missing value instead of pinning it. The «Girl Zone» label's `lang="en"` on a Romanian page (§679) stays as it was.
changelogLine: - **This club's own sentences live in `club/messages`** — the platform's catalogues are neutral, Brașov's home page, places, history and plan are an overlay merged over them, and the club's mark, card example, safety form, slug and zone arrive as arguments; every page and email reads as before. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: The platform's catalogues (`messages/<locale>.json`) say none of the club's words; the club's own sentences are `club/messages/<locale>.json`, stamped with the club's slug, holding only keys the platform's catalogue has (the redesign plan apart) with the same arguments in both languages, merged over it by `src/i18n/catalogue.ts` — the only file under `src/` that imports either — so that a page, an email and a PDF read the merged words (2026-11-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The club's short mark, identity card example, safety form's name, slug, media bucket and zone reach a message as `{short}`, `{idExample}`, `{safetyName}`, `{slug}`, `{bucket}`, `{timeZone}` and `{zoneWords}`, each passed at its call from `brand.ts`, `place.ts`, `dates.ts` or `R2_BUCKET`; with an empty overlay, no message of the merged catalogue formatted with a made-up club's values says this club's words, and the member mark is the made-up club's (2026-11-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the platform's words neutral, this club's own sentences in club/messages
